title: The shared finite-Hom monoidality predicate
statement: For monoidal categories C,Cprime, a functor F, specified tensor and unit comparison data and specified braiding data [def-sfb-strong-monoidal-functor], FiniteHomDomainMonoidal means that a CoreMonoidal structure on F has inverse unit and inverse tensorators heterogeneously equal to the specified comparisons, and has actual source and target braiding isomorphisms heterogeneously equal to the specified braiding data, satisfying the braided-functor square. This is the unchanged predicate previously declared in FiniteHomDomainCalculus.

proof.text: Write the existential CoreMonoidal structure, the heterogeneous equalities identifying its unit and tensorators, and the existential source and target braiding isomorphisms with their identifications and compatibility square.
